title: Choose the visual world for the dashboard (bolder hand)
question: Foreign forms at full commitment. The deal put Ikeda Datamatics first; Airport Yellow Wayfinding beat it on both axes.

options.label: Ikeda Datamatics
options.lineage: Ryoji Ikeda's data-sublime installations (datamatics, test pattern)
options.thesis: All 1,270 open PRs at once as a black-and-white barcode field: every hairline bar is one real PR, its length its wait, packed into its whose-move queue.
options.viewport: A full-bleed field of 1,270 bars split into five queues, the review column visibly the densest and longest; one monospace line states the finding; clicking a bar inverts the frame and pulls that PR's numbers into focus.
options.risk: Can read as art before analysis, and strobing must stay off by default; a 30-second reader needs the one-line finding to land first.

raised.raise: Density courage: PR lists and the SIG table set small and tight, nothing padded.
Packet to sheet: a compact first view that unfolds into every SIG and every PR.
Every block can be cut open to show the PRs it is made of.

options.label: Airport Yellow Wayfinding
options.thesis: The review pipeline signed like a terminal: each stage a yellow overhead band giving how many PRs are waiting there and for how long.
options.viewport: One yellow band across the top: 'Review · 368 PRs waiting · median 69 days', the number monumental; below, a chain of stage bands down to Merge ('1.7 hours'), the slowest marked by its sheer size; queues by SIG listed like gates.
options.case: Wins both axes: everyone has stood under these signs, and signage states the finding in plain words at a glance.
options.risk: Yellow at page scale is loud; it must stay reserved for wayfinding or it reads as a warning page.

options.label: Jackfield Normalling Schedule
options.thesis: Each SIG a numbered lane on black glass, its queues tied by amber link lines whose stroke says whose move it is.
options.viewport: Numbered SIG lanes under a fixed legend; unbroken lines for queues moving, gapped lines for no response, doubled lines for the ranked bottlenecks.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: state by stroke maps to whose move; loses on audience, since few readers know patch bays.
options.risk: Needs a key before it reads.

options.label: Japanese High-Density Web
options.thesis: Every queue, SIG and brief bullet packed into ruled modules on one screen.
options.viewport: A mosaic of modules, one per finding.
options.case: Shows everything and buries the one finding a 30-second reader needs.

options.label: Miura-Fold Sheet
options.thesis: A compact packet that unfolds into the full picture.
options.viewport: A folded summary that opens into SIG detail.
options.case: The fold metaphor costs more than it explains.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Queues as cloud blocks cut open to show their PRs.
options.viewport: A quarry of cloud blocks sized by PR-days.
options.case: Whimsy undercuts a page about real people's waiting work.
options.kept: Cut any block open to see what it holds.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An engineering-metrics dashboard: KPI tiles, bar charts and a sortable table, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Headline tiles, then the brief, the ranked table and the charts, as the page looks today.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every analytics product by design.
